title: Domain timber dowel connector

sourceOracles.coverage: TimberDowelConnector construction and downstream composite-beam use; direct connector methods, serialization and error parity are covered by the independent live test

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript TimberDowelConnector classes, including exact unit conversion, numerical resistance modes, JSON serialization, Unicode, inheritance boundaries, cloning and error-path comparisons.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for normalized connector and resistance fields
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for converted properties, embedment, yield moment and timber-timber resistance modes
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source TimberDowelConnector defaults, inherited shear-connector normalization, unit conversion, numerical resistance modes, metadata, serialization and errors.
TecnariaConnector and catalog dependencies, connector factories, timber material classes and composite-beam applications remain outside this bounded slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic timber dowel connector stiffness, resistance-mode calculation and serializable properties only; no connector catalog or composite-beam application is introduced.
